What do you need from us?
3–5 photos of each friend (face, full body, a typical outfit), photos or pins of your places, and the stories. Every person in the game signs a short consent form.
What do we play it on?
Any laptop or desktop browser, nothing to install. It's played with a keyboard; phones show a short “open this on a laptop” card.
Yes. You approve the faces first, then play a preview. Standard includes one round of changes, Deluxe two, Ultimate three. A Flex Pass adds one more.
What if we don't like it?
You see your characters within 5 days. If you don't love the preview, you get a full refund before we build the game.
They're only used to make your game, and deleted 30 days after delivery. We never use photos of children, celebrities or brands.
The organiser pays once, in full or spread with Klarna. Your order summary shows each friend's share and a message to send the group.
Is the art made with AI?
We use AI tools to help draw characters from your photos, then check and fix every image by hand. Nothing is published without your approval.
